text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's start with some stretches!
First, please pair up into groups of two.

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, let's do it together!
C'mon, let's do it, let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Taishin-san!
If you haven't picked a partner yet... wanna team up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... jeez. The whole "pair up with someone" thing is seriously the worst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Acting all cheerful and charming is totally out of the question for me.
They must've thought they drew the short straw...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin didn't really seem to have
her heart in her training that day...
